about.title: About First Trip
about.storyText: First Trip started in 2017 as a tourism company specializing in organizing trips from Egyptian governorates to Dahab. Over 6 years, we organized hundreds of trips and earned the trust of thousands of customers. After our 2026 relaunch, we're back stronger and better — with the same spirit and service quality we're known for.
about.visionText: To be the first choice for anyone wanting to visit Dahab — providing a complete tourism experience combining comfort, adventure, and the best prices.
about.missionText: Organizing safe, enjoyable, and competitively priced trips — connecting Egyptian governorates to the beauty of Dahab and Sinai.

policy.title: Policy & Refund
policy.bookingText: Booking is confirmed after paying a 50% deposit of the total trip value. The remaining 50% is paid upon arrival in Dahab. Payment can be made via bank transfer or Vodafone Cash.
policy.cancellationText: Cancellation 7+ days before trip date: Full deposit refund. Cancellation 3-6 days before: 50% deposit refund. Cancellation less than 48 hours before: No refund.
